channel.title: The Argo: the house of kakashi.eth
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Alkmachos #4170 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus))
item.description: Alkmachos #4170 was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Udaeus)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.description: Glaukmenes #1157 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (1×). The House of Echion made room at the fire, but no one sat close.
